Benchtop Waveform & Calibration Guide
Public Synthetic Fixture (CC BY 4.0) - Vector-Subfigures-Guide.pdf
Section 1: Overview
This public synthetic calibration guide documents two-channel benchtop acquisition.
Default sampling interval is fixed at 0.25 ms with a 50-ohm termination impedance.
All measurements are recorded at an ambient reference temperature of 23.0 C after
a 15-minute warm-up period.
